description.value: La Maison Da Nang is a family-owned casual Vietnamese restaurant on Victoria Drive in Vancouver's southeast, specializing in the regional cuisine of Da Nang in Central Vietnam. The restaurant features both indoor seating and a street-facing outdoor patio in a residential neighbourhood, offering a relaxed atmosphere with natural daylight. The menu focuses on authentic Central Vietnamese cooking, spanning side dishes, rice mains, soups, and desserts.
